name: 36104 · Montgomery, AL
findings: ZIP 36104 (Montgomery) has 221 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36104 (Montgomery) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36104 (Montgomery) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 8.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 89 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.
